# SS TECH SERVICES

> Certified tech training academy and learning platform based in Lucknow, India — Cyber Security, Cloud, DevOps, Networking, Linux, Data/AI and Full Stack, with capstone projects and placement support.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of courses, LMS and placement support.
- [About](/about): Company story, mission, vision and values.
- [Training Academy](/lms/courses): Full course catalogue.
- [My Learning](/lms): Student dashboard with progress and certificates.
- [Student Projects](/projects): Capstone projects built by students.
- [Careers](/careers): Open roles at SS TECH SERVICES.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phone, email and course inquiry form.
